text: No mainstream language designed after Java has adopted checked exceptions.
explanation: C#, Kotlin, Scala, Swift, Go and Rust all declined, several of their designers having written about the choice. Java's own newer APIs moved the same way — `java.time` throws an unchecked `DateTimeParseException` where `SimpleDateFormat` threw a checked `ParseException` — and lambdas cannot carry checked exceptions at all, which effectively settled it for new code. `UncheckedIOException` exists in the JDK specifically to wrap `IOException`.
